name: PHI De-identifier
description: Redact the 18 HIPAA Safe Harbor identifiers from clinical text (or produce a Limited Data Set) with consistent pseudonym tokens and an audit manifest of what was removed.
author: Rafael Lopez Alcaraz
coverImageAlt: Layered clinical records pass through a cyan privacy frame and emerge as anonymous geometric tokens.
coverImagePrompt:

Subject: layered paper-like clinical forms with purely abstract marks on one side, clean repeated geometric tokens and a small audit trail of matching shapes on the other
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; crop-safe focal subject; no essential detail in the outer 8%; strong left-to-right transformation with calm negative space
